interface.longDescription: 3DDDs Developer beta for testing the existing guided development cloud service. Connect your own account and explicitly choose an owned cloud project for saved work. This package includes no development repository access. Second-account installation, service access, isolation and save/reopen behavior require live acceptance testing.
